scientific_question: Can static nodewise BAM/raster representations be identical while distribution-forming topology, occurrence-to-occurrence relations, first-passage structure and intervention sensitivity differ?
scientific_motivation: Directly test the original EOG contrast between a flat cellwise distribution surface and a relational, flow-structured landscape.

virtual_world_panel.node_universe: active nodes plus four locally viable but movement-inaccessible outside nodes

shared_nodewise_state.M: the same active-node accessibility mask in every topology world
shared_nodewise_state.G: A intersect B intersect M, therefore the same active-node occurrence mask in every topology world
shared_nodewise_state.static_marginal_score: one deterministic response-independent score per node, identical across topology worlds and generated from seed 20261201 + active_node_count*1000 + replicate

topology_worlds.chain: source -> v1 -> v2 -> ... through every active node
topology_worlds.balanced_branching: source-rooted balanced binary tree over the same active nodes
topology_worlds.redundant: balanced branching backbone plus all source-to-active edges and deterministic cross-branch forward edges generated before scoring

virtual_world_panel.label_randomization: active non-source node labels are deterministically shuffled by replicate before constructing all four topologies; all worlds in a replicate share the same shuffled active-node set

topology_sensitive_targets.pairwise_relation_signature: directed reachability among all ordered active-node pairs
topology_sensitive_targets.route_redundancy_signature: number of active non-source nodes retaining source reachability after each single non-source node knockout
topology_sensitive_targets.critical_node_count: number of non-source nodes whose removal makes at least one other active node unreachable
topology_sensitive_targets.intervention_signature: vector of reachable active-node counts after every single non-source node knockout

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Within every replicate, all four topology worlds have identical A, B, M, G and static marginal-score vectors.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any violation is an implementation failure and stops interpretation.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Every eligible replicate contains at least two distinct ordered-pair reachability signatures among the four topology worlds.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if any replicate has one common relation signature across all four worlds.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Every eligible replicate contains at least two distinct source-first-passage signatures among the four topology worlds.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if any replicate has one common first-passage signature across all four worlds.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Every eligible replicate contains at least two distinct single-node intervention signatures among the four topology worlds.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if any replicate has one common intervention signature across all four worlds.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: For every replicate, the mean fraction of active nodes retained after single non-source node knockout is strictly larger in the redundant world than in the chain world.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if any replicate fails the strict directional comparison.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: In every replicate, the equivalence class induced by the complete static cellwise representation contains worlds with at least two distinct values for every topology-sensitive target family: relation, first-passage and intervention.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED separately if any target family is constant within the four-world static equivalence class for any replicate.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Even when the complete active-node G mask is observed, all four worlds remain statically indistinguishable while at least one topology-sensitive target differs.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any replicate in which complete G identifies topology refutes the claim.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Adding the pairwise relation signature splits the static four-world equivalence class in every replicate.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if the relation signature never partitions the static class in any replicate.

primary_outputs: number of distinct topology-sensitive target signatures per static-equivalence class
pairwise relation Hamming distance between topology worlds
static-equivalence class size before and after adding relational information

theoretical_boundary.statement: A deterministic target that differs among worlds with identical cellwise representations cannot be identified from that representation alone.
theoretical_boundary.novelty_claim: none for the generic marginal-versus-joint information theorem; the ecological test concerns which distributional-history quantities BAM/raster node masks discard

claim_boundary: The four topology classes are controlled virtual mechanisms, not estimates of real dispersal networks.
Static marginal equivalence does not imply that ordinary SDMs literally estimate the frozen synthetic marginal score used here.
A successful result establishes information insufficiency of nodewise representation for the declared topology targets, not empirical superiority of EOG in a real system.
stop_rules: Do not change topology classes after scoring.
Do not change active-node counts or replicate number after scoring.
Do not add a topology-sensitive feature to the static representation after scoring.
Do not remove a topology target that fails to differ.
Any failed M2-M8 direction remains failed.
